  1. MS Mass spectrometry characterizationConfirm what you made: intact mass, sequence coverage, post-translational modifications, glycans and process impurities. Intact and subunit massPeptide mapping and PTMsReleased N-glycan profileHost cell protein ID 4 assays4 papers and notes3–12 days standard

  3. BK Binding kinetics and potencyHow tightly, how fast and how much: kinetics, affinity, drug concentration in study samples and cell-based potency. Binding kinetics and affinityDrug concentrationCell-based potency 3 assays3 papers and notes6–14 days standard
  4. SB Structural biologyWhere it binds and what it looks like: crystallization screening, epitope mapping and higher-order structure. Epitope mappingCrystallization screening 2 assays3 papers and notes15–18 days standard

How a project runs

The turnaround clock starts when samples clear receiving, not when the quote is signed. Here's what happens either side of it.

  1. Week 0

    Scoping call

    A 30-minute call with the scientist who will run your study. We agree the question, the assays and what a useful answer looks like.

  2. 2 working days

    Study plan and quote

    A written plan listing methods, sample amounts, acceptance criteria and a fixed price. Nothing runs until you approve it.

  3. Day 1 of turnaround

    Samples in

    Receiving logs each tube against your manifest, checks temperature on arrival and emails you a receipt with photos.

  4. Per the matrix

    Data package

    Report, raw data and a debrief call. Questions after delivery are part of the study, not a new quote.

Sending samples

Ship Monday to Wednesday
So samples never sit on a dock over a weekend. Thursday shipments arrive Friday and are held frozen until Monday.
Label every tube
Use the sample IDs from your manifest. If you've asked for blinded coding, use your own codes and keep the key.
Frozen samples on dry ice
At least 5 kg for overnight delivery. Refrigerated samples go with gel packs and a temperature logger.
Include the manifest
One printed copy in the box and one emailed to receiving before the courier collects.
